<p align="center"><strong>Chapter two - restore the ward and free the stolen names.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key</small></p>


<p align="center">You leave the open gate behind. As you pass each pumpkin, it whispers a different name. Ada. Thomas. Nell. Some voices sound very old. None remember leaving this garden.</p>

<p align="center">Elias calls from the window, &quot;I built a light to send them home. She put it out.&quot; Another voice speaks through him: &quot;Such a helpful guest.&quot;</p>

<p align="center">Between the trees hangs a white Halloween mask. When you blink, it is one trunk closer.</p>

<p align="center">His note lists five parts of the ward: moonseed, copper coil, star lantern, northern bearing, beacon. The house has kept them apart. You still have the brass key.</p>
